marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major AI chip suppliers and cloud infrastructure providers reported sustained capex growth and strong quarterly order backlogs.
marketLayer.inference: High valuation multiples for mega-cap technology stocks remain supported by earnings visibility, driving momentum across US tech benchmarks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Supply chain bottlenecks in advanced packaging capacity and tightening international trade regulations.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet Sector & Southbound Capital Inflows
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed internet leaders expanded share repurchases, while net daily buying via Southbound Stock Connect reached a monthly peak.
marketLayer.inference: Enhanced corporate capital return strategies are establishing a valuation floor for the Hang Seng Index, appealing to dividend and value-oriented funds.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of domestic consumer sentiment recovery and macroeconomic policy stimulus transmission.

marketLayer.title: US Monetary Policy & Global Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: Cooling US inflation metrics reinforced market pricing for upcoming Federal Reserve rate cuts, lowering benchmark 10-year Treasury yields.
marketLayer.inference: Easing monetary conditions are reducing pressure on emerging market assets and improving liquidity conditions for HK/US growth stocks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Persistence of service sector inflation and potential volatility in US fiscal debt issuance.
